answer: Bounded invitation supply resists sybils: new identities enter only through invites, and each account issues only a few per epoch — a scarce relic, not a velvet-rope free-for-all. Mass fakery then needs a real tree of inviters, and misbehavior echoes back: if an invitee is caught cheating, the inviter's own standing is docked. Sponsors therefore gate who they admit, so a swarm cannot self-manufacture a million entries from one seat.
